data.description:
## Observation

`make verify` on 2026-11-16 (worktree at b4e0d01b6491 plus an unrelated MCP change; load average 17-44 from concurrent verifies on the host) failed exactly 1 of 21,307 default-tier tests:

`tests/scripts/test_observability_interrupt_reasons.py::test_each_reason_counter_keeps_its_own_offset` raised `subprocess.TimeoutExpired`: `bash infra/scripts/observability.sh` exceeded the test's `run_observability(..., timeout=60)` bound.

Rerun alone on the same tree at load ~11: all 5 tests in the file passed in 43.7 s wall (2 min 04 s including collection), so a single script invocation runs within a factor of a few of the 60 s bound even on a moderately loaded host.

## Hypotheses (unproven)

- The fixed 60 s wall-clock bound is too tight for `observability.sh` under host load (the script forks many subprocesses).
- The script blocks on some host resource under load (journal read, process spawn) that the test isolation in edf66bc13a0 does not stub.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Root-cause the timeout with a deterministic reproduction (e.g. constrained CPU) and record the cause here.
- [ ] Fix the class so the test does not depend on host load to pass, without adding a config key, env var or flag.
data.title: test_each_reason_counter_keeps_its_own_offset times out at 60 s under host load in make verify
